# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Each command builds on the last. You cannot stand firm if you are not watchful. You cannot act like men if you have not first stood your ground. And strength? That comes not from your own reserves, but from a life surrendered to Christ.

Men, the world tells you that strength is measured by your bank account, your bench press, or your title. But biblical strength is different. It is the quiet resolve to do what is right when no one is watching. It is the courage to lead your family in prayer. It is the discipline to get up early, open your Bible, and seek God before you seek the day's demands.

You will face opposition today—temptation, discouragement, laziness, pride. The enemy does not take days off. Neither should your vigilance. But here is the good news: you do not fight alone. The same Spirit that raised Christ from the dead lives in you. So rise, warrior. Put on your armor. Stand firm. Act like men. Be strong.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, thank God for the strength He gives you—not just in your muscles, but in your spirit. Then spend five minutes in prayer, asking Him to make you watchful and firm today.
